rows.grounds: direct object of the action of conquering
genitive specifying the target of paralysis

items.question: What dominion over armies and camels is attributed to the Vaṭuka?
premises: The Vaṭuka conquers a four-limbed army.
The Vaṭuka causes the paralysis of camels.
items.inference: The Vaṭuka possesses power to subdue military forces and immobilize animals.
uncertainties: The referent of stambhakārakam is supplied from the preceding verse's vaṭukaṃ.
items.plain_english: Having conquered a four-limbed army, he causes the paralysis of camels.
